floodplains_of_liscor.name: Floodplains of Liscor

canon_ref.note: Seen from 1.00; named by Pisces in 1.08.

floodplains_of_liscor.summary: Rolling hills and hidden valleys of autumn grass in bands of green, orange and purple, walled by huge mountains. Easy to get lost in. Border of the Drake lands to the south.

wandering_inn.name: The abandoned inn on the hill

canon_ref.note: Erin paints the name 'The Wandering Inn' on the sign on day 13 (1.18); flag wandering_inn.named. The name field keeps the day-8 name.

wandering_inn.summary: Large old wooden inn on a high hill: common room, long bar, kitchen with stone oven, upstairs rooms. Last of a small settlement that died of plague about ten years ago. No law stops anyone living there.

inn_stream.name: Stream near the inn
inn_stream.summary: Cold, fast, shoulder-deep stream of mountain water a few hundred feet from the inn. Drinking and washing spot for Erin and the Goblins. Flat, toothy, four-eyed fish hunt in it.

amentus_orchard.name: Blue fruit valley

canon_ref.note: Fruit named Amentus by Pisces in 1.08.

amentus_orchard.summary: Small valley east of the inn full of thin, very tough grey trees with blue fruit. Kick a tree and ripe fruit drops. Goblins forage here too.

razorbeak_nests.name: Razorbeak nesting ground

canon_ref.note: Nests found in open grass on the way to the stream; exact spot is not fixed.

razorbeak_nests.summary: Ground nests of Razorbeaks in the long grass. A big messy nest holds prey remains; smaller nests hold large pale eggs. Adults dive and peck at thieves.

goblin_cave.name: Goblin tribe cave

canon_ref.note: Distance and direction from the inn not given.

goblin_cave.summary: Small, wet, dark cave home of a small Goblin tribe. The way in is a narrow gap you roll under and crawl through; the Chieftain sometimes gets stuck.

liscor.name: Liscor

canon_ref.note: Seen as a far stone wall in 1.01; named in 1.06.

liscor.summary: Walled Drake city about twenty minutes' walk from the inn. Watch is mostly Drakes, a few tall furry guards, and one Antinium. People with a criminal record are not welcome.

liscor_walls.name: Liscor city walls
liscor_walls.summary: Watch posts on Liscor's wall. Guards there look out over the Floodplains for monsters, Goblins and smoke.

liscor_watch_barracks.name: Liscor Watch barracks
liscor_watch_barracks.summary: Barracks of the City Watch. Guards sign in and out in a ledger here. The Watch Captain's office is upstairs.

liscor_market.name: Liscor marketplace
liscor_market.summary: Liscor's market square. Scene of an evening brawl that pulled in the whole Watch on day 6.

high_passes.name: The High Passes

canon_ref.note: Seen from 1.00; named in 1.19R. 1.20R: Runners call it a Gold- or Named-rank danger.

high_passes.summary: Vast cloud-topped range that splits the continent of Izril into north and south and walls the Floodplains. Many monsters; more Runners die there than anywhere near.

dragon_cave_lair.name: The Dragon's first cave

canon_ref.note: In or near the mountains: Erin ran from it into the plains. Exact place unknown.

dragon_cave_lair.summary: Cave where Erin appears. A Dragon sleeps there behind hundreds of warding spells. He abandons it after she wakes him.

dragon_backup_lair.name: The Dragon's backup lair

canon_ref.note: Location unknown. He dislikes its neighbours.

dragon_backup_lair.summary: Emergency lair the Dragon teleports to with his hoard. Harder to reach and more dangerous for visitors.

pallass.name: Pallass
pallass.summary: Drake city to the south. Sends high-grade healing potions to Liscor once the Blood Fields freeze. Pisces thinks a storm spell may have come from there.

blood_fields.name: The Blood Fields
blood_fields.summary: Area between Liscor and Pallass. Supply shipments only cross it once it is frozen in winter.

liscor_east_gate.name: Liscor east gate

canon_ref.note: Erin comes from the inn to the eastern gate. That the inn lies east of Liscor is a guess from this.

liscor_east_gate.summary: Two solid metal doors in a wall about forty feet high. Quiet: most visitors come from the north, or from the south in winter. Anyone may enter; the gates close at sundown. One guard on duty.

liscor_adventurers_guild.name: Liscor Adventurer's Guild
liscor_adventurers_guild.summary: Big hall like a tavern, full of armed Drake and Gnoll adventurers and a few mages. A receptionist's counter takes bounties and quests; a wooden board holds job notices.

liscor_mages_guild.name: Liscor Mage's Guild
liscor_mages_guild.summary: Large, busy building marked with a crystal ball and a wand. Named by Drassi; Erin only sees it from outside.

liscor_plaza.name: Liscor central plaza

canon_ref.note: Erin guesses the pillared building is a city hall; it bears the city sigil.

liscor_plaza.summary: Open square with benches, trees and a children's play area. At one end stands a pillared public building with the Liscor sigil.

krshia_stall.name: Krshia's Silverfang Goods
krshia_stall.summary: One of the larger stalls in the food section of the market, under a thin canopy. Sells food and many other goods. Run by the Gnoll Krshia.

lism_stall.name: Lism's dry goods stall

canon_ref.note: Stall name not given; id uses the owner's name.

lism_stall.summary: Stall next to Krshia's with sacks and sample bins of flour, salt and sugar, dried onions, garlic, roots, spices, and sausages on hooks. Prices on paper signs in Drake script.

goblin_grave.name: Goblin grave

canon_ref.note: At the foot of a hill, walking distance from the inn; exact spot not given.

goblin_grave.summary: Low mound of packed earth where Erin buried the two Goblins Relc killed, with their heads.

blighted_kingdom.name: The Blighted Kingdom

canon_ref.note: Text says 'kingdom of blight' and 'the Blighted King'; the continent is not named.

blighted_kingdom.summary: Distant Human kingdom ruled by the Blighted King and Queen, continents away from Liscor. Its mages hold a vast ritual underground to summon heroes.

celum.name: Celum
celum.summary: Walled Human city-state north of the High Passes, one of the southernmost before them. Has a [Mayor] and owes no noble house. Magnolia Reinhart keeps a mansion there.

remendia.name: Remendia

canon_ref.note: Distance and direction from Celum not given.

remendia.summary: Human city north of the High Passes. Its Runner's Guild is Ryoka's base and is better known than the city. Wales lies about thirty miles away.

remendia_runners_guild.name: Remendia Runner's Guild
remendia_runners_guild.summary: Old tavern turned Runner's Guild: counters with uniformed [Receptionists], wall maps pinned with local dangers, a cork board of requests, and tables where Runners gossip between jobs.

liscor_hive.name: The Hive under Liscor

canon_ref.note: Seen only in Klbkch's thoughts.

liscor_hive.summary: Antinium home below Liscor. The ground opens on one street of the city and only Antinium go down. Klbkch's Queen is there.

liscor_dungeon.name: Ruins near Liscor

canon_ref.note: Door dug out in 1.23A; 'ruins to the northeast' found in 1.24. That they are the same place is likely, not stated.

liscor_dungeon.summary: A tall hillside outside Liscor hides a huge weathered stone door into an ancient complex; something moves in the dark within. Liscor talks of it as a large, unexplored dungeon.

chandrar.name: Chandrar
chandrar.summary: Dry continent of deserts far to the south and west of Izril. Home of Reim, Nerrhavia, Medain, Germina and the rising Emperor of the Sands.

reim.name: Reim
reim.summary: Capital of Flos Reimarch's kingdom: a crown-shaped city with two fallen towers, a faded palace on a hill and hungry people after twenty-two years of decline.

ruins_of_albez.name: Ruins of Albez

canon_ref.note: Where it lies is not given; far north of Liscor, within a run of Wales.

ruins_of_albez.summary: Dug-out ruins of an old magic site on a leyline, once home to a Gnoll tribe. Stripped over eighty-nine years but still full of monsters; teams buy week-long permits to search it.

wales.name: Wales

canon_ref.note: Named in 1.20R, about thirty miles from Remendia; Ryoka runs from its Guild in 1.26R.

wales.summary: Human city in the north, bigger than Remendia and with better inns. Ryoka runs from its Runners' Guild to Celum in forty minutes.

wales_runners_guild.name: Wales Runners' Guild

canon_ref.note: Most cities have their own Runners', Mages', Merchants' and Adventurers' Guilds; Ryoka works from Remendia's (1.20R), Wales's (1.26R) and Celum's (1.33R).

wales_runners_guild.summary: The Runners' Guild where Ryoka reports the Lich delivery and takes Magnolia's rush job from under Persua's nose.

celum_runners_guild.name: Celum Runners' Guild

canon_ref.note: Magnolia calls its head 'Celum's Guildmaster'.

celum_runners_guild.summary: Celum's Runners' Guild, led by Guildmaster Eterell. Fals holds sway here. The unmarked High Passes request still hangs on its board.

magnolia_celum_mansion.name: Magnolia's Celum mansion

canon_ref.note: She calls it her vacation home in Celum (1.27R).

magnolia_celum_mansion.summary: Magnolia Reinhart's vacation home in Celum: a three-storey foyer, a pink drawing room and a rich kitchen with preservation runes and rune-lit stoves. A few streets from the Mage's Guild.

celum_rats_tail_inn.name: The Rat's Tail
celum_rats_tail_inn.summary: A modest, busy inn in Celum where the injured Ryoka rents a room. Calruz breaks its stairwell and pays for it.

selys_home.name: Selys's home

canon_ref.note: She offers it to Erin in 1.30.

selys_home.summary: Selys's roomy apartment in Liscor, with tall Drake-sized chairs. She makes root tea there and draws Erin a map of Izril.

raiders_grave.name: Raiders' grave

canon_ref.note: 1.31 says 'a mile away'; the user chose 1.30's several hundred feet.

raiders_grave.summary: Unmarked pit the Workers dug several hundred feet from the inn to bury the Goblins who raided it on day 21. Not the small grave of 1.13.

shield_spider_nest.name: Shield Spider nest

canon_ref.note: About a mile from the Krakk trees; direction from the inn not given. Burned out on day 25 (guess).

shield_spider_nest.summary: Huge pit under a false cover of dead grass, full of armoured Shield Spiders and egg sacs, with side tunnels. Steel cannot crack the adults; a nest is a Gold-rank job.

krakk_forest.name: Krakk tree wood

canon_ref.note: About forty minutes' walk from the inn.

krakk_forest.summary: Rare stand of bare, pale-barked trees on the Floodplains. A hard knock makes a Krakk tree burst and spray its branches like shrapnel. Once burst, the wood is safe and burns well.

esthelm.name: Esthelm

canon_ref.note: Also named in 1.37 (ore from Esthelm) and 1.44R (about sixty miles south of Celum, near the road to Liscor).

esthelm.summary: One of the two cities on the safe road through the High Passes, with Liscor. Ships ore south. The Horns of Hammerad gather there before they try the ruins near Liscor.

teriarch_cave.name: Teriarch's cave

canon_ref.note: Off the rough road through the High Passes; a yellow banner marks it for the Runner request. Whether it is the Dragon's backup lair of 1.01 is not confirmed.

teriarch_cave.summary: Cave mouth big enough for a ship, opening into a hollowed mountain full of books, arms, tapestries, magic items and an alchemy lab. Gargoyles, Carn Wolves and killer goats live nearby, but none follow a visitor inside.

esthelm_adventurers_guild.name: Esthelm Adventurers' Guild

canon_ref.note: Mess hall and courtyard from 1.47R-1.48R.

esthelm_adventurers_guild.summary: Big guild hall in Esthelm with rooms to rent upstairs, a guild shop, a loud mess hall like a school canteen and an open yard for sparring. The Horns of Hammerad stay here before the ruins.

krshia_home.name: Krshia's home
krshia_home.summary: Krshia's rooms in Liscor: rugs, pillows and big padded chairs, less tidy than her stall. She hosts Erin there with tea and cubes of raw meat.
